images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. A premium editorial architectural photograph for XENISO, a medical student's interdisciplinary career exploration platform, feature image for personal profile. A serene contemporary university study room, a generous pale limestone desk close to camera, an open ivory notebook with absolutely blank pages, two translucent sage and slate-blue glass sheets, a graphite pencil, soft daylight through a tall window at left, green trees outside gently out of focus. Carefully composed tactile materials, natural shadows, architectural magazine quality, quiet cinematic realism. The objects feel used thoughtfully, not an icon arrangement. Unified series palette: chalk white, cool grey, muted eucalyptus green, subdued blue-grey. Landscape 3:2, large central subject, readable at card size, uncluttered edges, no people, no letters or numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no interface screenshots, no fake charts, no clipart, no vector illustration, no neon, no futuristic holograms.

The scene communicates different perspectives coming together through physical materials. Refined high-end architecture magazine art direction, tactile stone and glass, beautifully controlled natural daylight from left, realistic photography, spacious composition. Palette chalk white, cool grey, muted eucalyptus green, subdued slate blue. Landscape 3:2, strong central composition readable at card size. No people, text, numbers, logos, charts, UI, iconography, neon, glowing objects, holograms, vector illustration, watermark.

Use case: stylized-concept. A restrained cinematic still frame to serve as an image-to-video reference for the background of a premium academic community website. Wide 16:9 frame. A continuous near-white cool ivory atmosphere, with fine sparse eucalyptus-green and slate-blue-grey dust-like translucent particles drifting at far left and far right edges. Very subtle optical depth: most tiny particles 1 to 3 pixels, a few 5 to 8 pixels softly out of focus, no large spheres. The central sixty percent of the image must be nearly empty light grey-white to remain readable behind an HTML forum list. Soft diffused daylight, delicate organic distribution and photographic grain, understated and calm. Particles must look like fine airborne motes, not glitter. No letters, text, logo, people, objects, interface, stars, constellations, glowing connection lines, neon, vivid gradients or lens flares. Fixed camera reference; no suggestion of zoom or tunnel.
